To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
level crossing rate and duration of fades in subchannels of MIM0 channel can be analyzed using the proposed model.
the exact analytical expressions for the level crossing rate in the MIMO subchannels are derived.
the level crossing rate and the average fading duration in the MIMO channel depend on the number of antennas and on the spatial correlation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of level crossing rates and average fading duration for the orthogonal subchannels of a MIMO system with spatially correlated Rayleigh fading.
analysis of MIMO system with correlated subchannels and space and time correlation.
the level crossing rate and the average fading duration in the orthogonal subchannels of a MIMO system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
in case of MIMO channel, the level crossing rate in subchannels is higher than the level crossing rate of the overall signal.
in MIMO channel the subchannels with high correlation are characterized by high level crossing rate and short average fading duration.
in MIMO system with space correlation the average level crossing rate and the average fading duration are smaller than in MIMO system without space correlation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the level crossing rate in MIMO channel is higher than the one in SISO channel.
the level crossing rate in MIMO subchannels is higher than in single input single output (SISO) channels.
the level crossing rate and the average fading duration are not independent of the number of subchannels in MIMO channel.
The main takeaway from our work is that
level crossing rate and fade duration in MIMO channel is significantly lower than in single-input single-output (SISO) channel, which is important for design of MIMO receivers.
in the case of space correlation the level crossing rate in MIMO system is higher and the average fading duration is lower than in the case of uncorrelated channels.
the level crossing rate and the average fading duration in MIMO subchannels are significantly higher than in the single antenna system.
